title: Rozriad
noGlHint: This browser has no WebGL2 — open it in Chrome or Firefox
profTagline: A field of a million bits your phone recomputes every frame. Touch it and the bits boil and discharge; the terminal on top reads the address and colour of the pixel under your finger.
installDesc: Opens like an app, straight into the field
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
